painting.title: Painting
painting.shortDesc: Interior and exterior painting with premium materials.
painting.description: Transform your home with a fresh coat of paint. We handle interior and exterior projects of all sizes — from a single room to a full house repaint. We use premium, low-VOC paints and leave your space clean.

remodeling.title: Remodeling
remodeling.description: Modernize your kitchen, bathroom, or any living space. We handle design coordination, demolition, and build-out — all in one crew. No need to manage multiple contractors.

construction.title: Construction
construction.shortDesc: Additions, decks, fences, and structural work.
construction.description: From room additions to new decks and fences, we handle structural work that adds real value to your property. All work is permitted and up to Florida building code.

plumbing.title: Plumbing
plumbing.description: Leaky pipes, new fixture installs, or a full bathroom plumbing rough-in — we've got it covered. Fast response and clean workmanship.

electrical.title: Electrical
electrical.description: Panel upgrades, outlet installs, ceiling fans, recessed lighting — all electrical work is done to code and inspected for safety. We don't cut corners on electrical.
